'''Polearm One''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by [[Todra Mayn]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] who was the commanding officer of [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadron]], a unit of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|Starfighter Command]] that flew [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]]. She used this call sign while participating in [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] campaign against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and his [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']].
